description: Header file defining the SymbolTable class and related components for shader parsing and symbol management in the ANGLE project. It includes class declarations, enums, and function prototypes related to symbol handling, scope management, and built-in shader symbols.

classes.name: TSymbolTable
classes.description: Manages shader symbols, scopes, and built-in variables for shader parsing within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: VariableMetadata
classes.description: Stores metadata about variables such as static read/write flags and invariance.

classes.name: UnmangledEntry
classes.description: Represents an unmangled shader symbol entry with matching logic.

classes.name: SymbolRule
classes.description: Defines rules for symbol lookup and mangling based on shader specifications and extensions.

methods.name: TSymbolTable
methods.description: Constructor for the symbol table, initializes internal structures.

methods.name: ~TSymbolTable
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the symbol table is empty.

methods.name: atGlobalLevel
methods.description: Checks if the current scope is the global scope.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes a new scope level.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Pops the current scope level.

methods.name: declare
methods.description: Declares a symbol in the current scope.

methods.name: declareInternal
methods.description: Declares an internal variable.

methods.name: declareUserDefinedFunction
methods.description: Declares a user-defined function.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a symbol by name and shader version.

methods.name: findUserDefined
methods.description: Finds a user-defined symbol by name.

methods.name: findUserDefinedFunction
methods.description: Finds a user-defined function by name.

methods.name: findGlobal
methods.description: Finds a global symbol by name.

methods.name: findGlobalWithConversion
methods.description: Finds a global symbol with name conversion.

methods.name: findBuiltIn
methods.description: Finds a built-in symbol by name.

methods.name: findBuiltInWithConversion
methods.description: Finds a built-in symbol with name conversion.

methods.name: initializeBuiltIns
methods.description: Initializes built-in shader symbols based on shader type and resources.

methods.name: clearCompilationResults
methods.description: Clears previous compilation data.

methods.name: nextUniqueId
methods.description: Generates a new unique ID for symbols.

methods.name: isUnmangledBuiltInName
methods.description: Checks if a name corresponds to an unmangled built-in symbol.
